name: CorpStacking API
description: REST API for corporate, government, and ETF treasury holdings of Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana plus XRP (spot XRP funds and other holders we verify). Query holdings, SEC filings, prices, historical purchases, and a real-time signals feed. Every holdings figure ships with how it was verified and a link to its primary source. Authenticate with the x-api-key header (a key in the query string is not accepted). JSON responses are wrapped in { data, meta }; the raw downloads (CSV, JSON Lines) and the event stream are not. Errors are always { error: { code, message, request_id } } with the status listed on each operation. A failed data read is an error, never an empty result. Responses that depend on your key are Cache-Control: private; this document and /api/v1 are public and cacheable for an hour.
